Overview

Lipetsk is a city in Lipetsk Oblast with a population of 510,000. A major steel production center in the Black Earth region, known for the Novolipetsk Steel plant and its modern urban development. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
